comparison.objective: Unlock a jigsaw shoe, set a 45° bevel, relock it and release the saw; candidate separates media and washers.
comparison.physical_skill: Articulated-tool adjustment and clamp actuation versus bimanual screen support, pouring and bridge clearing.
comparison.success_condition: Shoe at 45±2°, clamped, still and hands clear for 2 s, with drop/loss vetoes; candidate succeeds through recovery fraction, retention and 3 s released support dwell.
comparison.reason: Angle setting and locking do not test granular separation.
